approval: Human: đo năng lực thực tế ngay
statementVerification: Original page1 visually inspected; projections rephrased with equivalent quantifiers/formulas, not reconstructed from memory
authentication: Existing ChatGPT login; no API-key fallback
requestAllocation: For BOTH arms: fresh attempt, fresh same-arm criticism, fresh final revision, each charged. toolPolicy: Identical local in-memory arithmetic/Python computation only; no reads/writes/network/web/MCP/plugins/extra agents. Task-root empty; prompt stdin only. Sandbox read-only; user-config ignored except explicit same configured model/effort/tier restored. Enforce observed command counts/elapsed; filesystem isolation is instructional not asserted hardened.
grading: After ALL six submissions sealed, two fresh arm-blinded pair-review sessions. First independent audit; second independent review plus bounded grader-only reference notes if safely acquired. No solution repair, no majority vote. Unresolved disagreement REVIEW_INCONCLUSIVE. No official score/formal verification/host universal certificate.
stopping: Arm-local exhaustion retains failure and moves to remaining original roster. Cohort integrity/unknown effect/outer deadline stops entire cohort. No swaps, cap increase, paid API, fallback or post-verdict repair.
